decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to have a resilient aggro strategy that utilizes cards like Martyr of Sands and Abiding Grace to gain life and stall the game, while also deploying threats like Ranger-Captain of Eos and White Orchid Phantom to apply pressure. The deck also includes some control elements with cards like Skyclave Apparition and Supreme Verdict to deal with opposing threats. The deck aims to control the board and outvalue the opponent while slowly gaining an advantage through life gain and card advantage.

The main concept of this deck revolves around utilizing powerful control spells, such as Counterspell and Solitude, to disrupt your opponent's strategy while protecting The One Ring, a key card in the deck. With a mix of efficient removal spells like Prismatic Ending and board wipes like Supreme Verdict, you can maintain control of the game until you can overwhelm your opponent with powerful threats like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. The deck also includes versatile planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler to further control the game and secure your victory.

The deck focuses on using Atraxa, Grand Unifier as a key piece in a combo that involves sacrificing creatures, using instant spells like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate to bring back powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Fallaji Archaeologist from the graveyard. The deck also utilizes cards like Psychic Frog and Leyline Binding to control the opponent's board. The goal is to quickly reanimate strong creatures and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence while disrupting their game plan with countermagic and removal spells.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using cards like Thundertrap Trainer, Tameshi, Reality Architect, and Hydroelectric Specimen to generate massive amounts of mana and deal direct damage to the opponent with spells like Goblin Charbelcher. The deck is designed to win the game without relying on traditional methods of playing lands, instead utilizing a variety of spells and abilities to control the game and build towards its combo finish. The inclusion of counter spells and disruption ensures that the deck can protect its key pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with a mix of efficient creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to play aggressively and maintain pressure on the opponent while using powerful cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to build a strong board presence. The inclusion of Static Prison helps control the opponent's board, allowing for the deck to continue its aggressive strategy without much interference. Jegantha, the Wellspring also provides additional value and ramp options for the deck.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures and using burn spells to clear the way for them to deal damage. The deck also utilizes static prison to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own creatures. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for additional mana ramp and deck building restrictions to be met. The overall strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient threats and maintain board control to secure a swift victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Combo potential of Broodscale Bloodchief by creating an engine with cards like Blade of the Bloodchief and Malevolent Rumble to generate powerful and impactful plays. The deck includes key pieces like Basking Broodscale and Glaring Fleshraker to enable the combo, while also utilizing cards like Kozilek's Command and Ancient Stirrings to search for key pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With strong ramp options like Urza's Saga and Eldrazi Temple, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a strong board presence.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, board wipes, and powerful creatures. The key card, The One Ring, allows you to manipulate the board state and gain an advantage over your opponent. With strong removal options like Solitude and Supreme Verdict, as well as disruptive spells like Spell Snare and Teferi, Time Raveler, you can stall your opponent's game plan while building up your own. The deck's mana base provides flexibility and consistency, ensuring you have access to the right colors of mana for your spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Underworld Breach combo to quickly cycle through the deck and win the game with Thassa's Oracle or Grinding Station. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provide card advantage and manipulation, while Urza's Saga and Mishra's Bauble help with artifact synergy. The One Ring is a key piece that can quickly generate mana to fuel the combo. Malevolent Rumble and Unholy Heat offer removal options, while Mox Amber and Spell Snare help with tempo plays. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and efficiently to secure victory.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt opponents with counterspells and removal while filling up the graveyard with cards like Thought Scour and Unearth to fuel graveyard synergies. Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog provide powerful threats, while Abhorrent Oculus and Harbinger of the Seas offer additional control elements. The deck aims to control the game by managing the opponent's resources and leveraging the graveyard for tempo advantage. The land base is designed for consistency and to support both blue and black mana requirements.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using Eldrazi Temple and Utopia Sprawl to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. It also utilizes control elements like Kozilek's Command and Kozilek's Return to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Malevolent Rumble provides board control while Sowing Mycospawn generates tokens for defense. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with big threats while controlling the game with a mix of removal and disruption. The deck aims to dominate the late game with its powerful Eldrazi creatures and versatile spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of low-cost creatures and powerful spells to quickly assemble a winning combo without relying on traditional land cards. By utilizing cards like Thundertrap Trainer and Hydroelectric Specimen for early pressure, alongside powerful disruption cards like Disrupting Shoal and Pact of Negation, the deck aims to win with cards like Goblin Charbelcher and Lotus Bloom. The inclusion of counter spells and card advantage engines like Jwari Disruption and Whir of Invention help to protect the combo and maintain a strong board presence.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly build up a board presence while gaining life through various means, such as using Martyr of Sands and Abiding Grace. The creatures in the deck are meant to apply pressure on the opponent and provide control through cards like Skyclave Apparition and Supreme Verdict. The inclusion of cards like Sevinne's Reclamation and Ephemerate offer ways to recur key pieces and protect important creatures. The deck also has a sub-theme of locking down opponents temporarily to buy time to establish a dominant board state.

This deck focuses on using The One Ring as a powerful control tool to manipulate the game in your favor. By combining countermagic like Spell Snare and Force of Negation with removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Solitude, you can control the board state and protect The One Ring. Consign to Memory allows you to bounce problematic permanents, while Nulldrifter and Phlage provide additional value and threats. Teferi, Time Raveler helps disrupt your opponent's plans, while card draw and selection tools like Dress Down and Meticulous Archive help you find your key pieces.

This deck focuses on utilizing the combo potential of Underworld Breach and Thassa's Oracle to win the game quickly. The key strategy involves casting a sequence of spells to fill the graveyard and then utilizing Breach to cast Thassa's Oracle multiple times in a single turn to win the game by emptying the library. The deck includes various ways to dig for combo pieces and protect the combo with disruption spells. The land base is optimized to support the combo by producing the necessary colors of mana.

The main theme of this deck is centered around utilizing the Urza lands (Urza's Tower, Urza's Power Plant, and Urza's Mine) to ramp up quickly to powerful colorless spells and Eldrazi creatures. The deck focuses on control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy while also having a late-game win condition with cards like Ugin, the Spirit Dragon and Emrakul, the Promised End. Karn, the Great Creator serves as a versatile tool to search for key artifacts and shut down opponent's artifact strategies. The deck also includes powerful board wipes and removal to maintain board control.
